content.title: Cardi B Says She Was “Reborn” After Offset Divorce | E! News
content.text: Cardi B is opening up about one of the biggest turning points of her life, and she says it changed everything. In a new interview on the 'Aspire with Emma Grede' podcast, the rapper reflected on how filing for divorce from Offset in 2024 sparked a powerful personal and professional transformation. After years of an on‑again, off‑again relationship, Cardi revealed she feels like a completely new version of herself has emerged, saying she was “reborn” during the past year. The “Bodak Yellow” star first filed for divorce in 2020 before reconciling, but later confirmed the split was “a long time coming.” Since then, Cardi — a mom to Kulture, Wave, Blossom, and a baby boy with Stefon Diggs — says she’s more motivated than ever to lock in and build her own empire.
